sqlQuery.name: ByAttributes
sqlQuery.sql: SELECT c.comment_id FROM @REMOTE_COMMENT_SCHEMA@comments c LEFT JOIN @REMOTE_COMMENT_SCHEMA@comment_users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN @REMOTE_COMMENT_SCHEMA@comment_ai_provenance aiprov ON c.comment_id = aiprov.comment_id WHERE c.comment_date >= $$date.min$$ AND c.comment_date <= $$date.max$$ + 1 AND lower(c.project_name) LIKE lower(REPLACE($$project_id$$,'*','%')) AND (c.project_name = '@PROJECT_ID@' or 'UniDB' = '@PROJECT_ID@') AND lower(CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name)) LIKE lower(REPLACE($$user_name$$,'*','%')) AND lower(u.organization) LIKE lower(REPLACE($$organization$$,'*','%')) AND lower(c.email) LIKE lower(REPLACE($$email$$,'*','%')) AND c.comment_target_id = $$type$$ AND ( $$is_ai_generated$$ = 'Any' OR ($$is_ai_generated$$ = 'Yes' AND aiprov.comment_id IS NOT NULL) OR ($$is_ai_generated$$ = 'No' AND aiprov.comment_id IS NULL) )
